# LinkAGI

> LinkAGI is an operator-maintained, Chinese-language AI API relay with CNY usage-based billing. This site provides its API starter resources and setup guide.

Users can create separate API keys for projects, select a model and group, and inspect per-request token usage and charges. Current model availability and pricing are published in the model marketplace. Join QQ group 342205412 and comment on the promotion post at https://www.v2ex.com/t/1255536 to claim CNY 5 in API trial credit.

## Product and account

- [English overview](https://16871233.github.io/linkagi-api-starter/en.html): Product, billing and developer resources in English.

- [Website](https://api.linktoagi.com/): LinkAGI product homepage.
- [Sign up](https://api.linktoagi.com/sign-up): Create an account.
- [Models and pricing](https://api.linktoagi.com/pricing): Current models, groups and prices.
- [Support](https://docs.linktoagi.com/about.html#support): Customer support and trial requests.
- [Trial contact guide](https://16871233.github.io/linkagi-api-starter/#trial): Customer support QR code, business email and QQ group 342205412.

Current Codex group multipliers are Sale 0.08, Plus 0.15 and Pro 0.25. Model input, output, cache and service-tier prices are listed in the live model marketplace. Each CNY 20 of eligible API consumption earns one draw, with prizes up to CNY 100 in site credit; see the console wallet for participation.

## Integration resources

- [API error guide](https://16871233.github.io/linkagi-api-starter/api-errors.html): Troubleshoot authentication, model routing, rate limits and timeouts; includes client setup and trial links.

- [Setup and token-cost calculator](https://16871233.github.io/linkagi-api-starter/): Client-specific base URLs, live pricing links and a local calculator.
- [GPT group selection](https://16871233.github.io/linkagi-api-starter/gpt-groups.html): Sale 0.08, Plus 0.15 and Pro 0.25 group multipliers, live pricing and trial entry.
- [Chinese documentation](https://docs.linktoagi.com/): Client configuration instructions.
- [OpenAPI specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/16871233/linkagi-api-starter/main/openapi/linkagi.openapi.json): Starter request schema.
- [Integration status](https://github.com/16871233/linkagi-api-starter/blob/main/INTEGRATION_STATUS.md): Scope and evidence of completed interface tests.

The OpenAI-compatible base URL is `https://api.linktoagi.com/v1`. Check each model's endpoint type and the current client restrictions in the model marketplace and site announcements. An account API key and calling balance are required. Never send API keys to this static documentation site. LinkAGI is an independent third-party service.
